scope: Resident solved fields, listener maps, adjoint RHS and treatment sensitivities in frequency-local room MMA

fixture.mesh: 4x4 triangular grid, P1, actual stiffness/mass and two boundary mass forms
fixture.preconditioner_policy: Explicit lagging at initial treatment; reprepare on unsuitable action, no fallback
fixture.oracle: CPU direct solves of the same physical system and finite differences of its objective
fixture.reuse: Three design evaluations plus four MMA iterations, separate retained forward and adjoint sessions
fixture.boundaries: Device sparse listener and Hermitian listener maps; host listener-sized log-power objective and gradient; device treatment SpMV and Hermitian dot; host MMA and compact solver controls
fixture.failure: Injected D2D transfer failure returns error; repaired next evaluation matches CPU; invalid physics and unsupported Direct reject
fixture.resident_update: A(t) = A_base + sum(t_i T_i) and corresponding Hermitian bases; no host sparse assembly or full matrix uploads per design
fixture.listeners: Three listeners including complex interpolation weights and duplicate entries at one DOF; duplicate CSR entries canonicalized
fixture.resident_fields: Forward and Hermitian certified solution vectors never download during objective_gradient
fixture.sensitivity_storage: One mutable retained CSR descriptor and one action vector reused for every derivative; values copied from existing resident forward treatment bases

assertions.gradient_phase_recorded_d2h_bytes_upper_: 16 * treatment_count; vendor host-result scalar reductions may not increment transfer counters

results.registry: 40 retained-dispatch rows; zero complete; validator and 10 audit tests passed

limitations: No controlled performance measurement or speedup claim
No multi-frequency treatment or CLI integration
Listener-sized nonlinear objective/gradient, MMA and compact Krylov controls remain host work
Owned sparse descriptor/storage allocations retain existing backend quota policy; pooled vector buffers enforce pool cap
Bounded P1 2D validation, not all geometries/orders/materials
